occupancy_definition: Independent request_tokens / max_input_tokens and uncropped deduplicated capped recent_tokens / recent_context_tokens; either >=soft queues at commit, either >=hard waits or runs synchronously at load. No row trigger or workflow boundary trigger.
stop_rule: Stop conversation on runtime exception or pending owner input; preserve every attempt, no replacement samples. Shutdown drains outstanding jobs only after last turn.
grading: Verify background calls actually occurred, pressure crossed 0.6 and 0.75 somewhere in stress captures, retain every provider/schema failure. Gap20 target near-zero waits and zero synchronous summaries; gap0 is worst case, not required to pass this latency target. Returned turns are completion counts, not task-quality successes.
measurement: Per-turn run_turn wall excludes measured reading gap. Individually report waits, synchronous work, background calls and failures; background traces after TurnCompleted do not increase foreground wall.
limits: One dependent 18-turn chain per group; not independent model-quality samples or natural traffic. Authored stress inputs include three long documents; history seeded directly. Fixed gap20 is assumed. Full working tree source includes pre-existing unrelated receipt-delivery edits; do not claim clean-commit causal A/B latency.
